prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a futuristic vehicle dashboard, dominated by a large, glowing red warning display at the center that reads "SPEED ALERT" in bold white letters, flanked by two triangular warning icons. The interface is sleek and high-tech, with a dark, metallic blue color palette accented by vibrant neon lights. To the right of the warning, a control panel features a prominent illuminated red button, several smaller blue and white indicator lights, and a grid of labeled buttons with alphanumeric codes. The lighting is moody and cinematic, casting subtle reflections and emphasizing the glossy surfaces of the controls. The overall style evokes a tense, sci-fi atmosphere, with sharp focus on the digital readouts and a shallow depth of field that blurs the background, drawing attention to the urgent alert and the intricate details of the dashboard. The composition is precise and symmetrical, conveying a sense of high-stakes technology and imminent action.
